request.description: A read link valid for 5 minutes, served with the detected content type. Only for files that passed the malware scan (409 `DOCUMENT_NOT_READY` while scanning or after rejection). Every link issued is recorded in the audit log. Borrowers see the documents of their own borrower profiles and applications; staff see them by role (ops and compliance can also download; support sees metadata only). Others get 404.
